metadata.question: Did the NVDI within a 10 mile raidus over coordinates (39.493523, -122.107805) decrease between September 4, 2021 and Septebmer 16, 2022?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about NDVI change between two specific dates (Sept 4, 2021 and Sept 16, 2022) within a 10-mile radius around coordinates (39.493523, -122.107805). Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-2 data for NDVI calculation 2. Create a 10-mile radius buffer around the point 3. Get images for both dates (with some tolerance window) 4. Calculate mean NDVI for each date 5. Compare if NDVI decreased Data quality considerations: - Check if images exist for both dates - Check if valid pixels exist after cloud masking - Validate NDVI values are within reasonable range (-1 to 1) I'll use: - Sentinel-2 surface reflectance collection - Cloud masking using QA60 band - NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) - Mean NDVI calculation over the region - Fallback to wider date window if no images found ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.107805, 39.493523]); const radiusMeters = 10 * 1609.34; // 10 miles to meters const geometry = point.buffer(radiusMeters); const date1 = '2021-09-04'; const date2 = '2022-09-16'; const toleranceDays = 5; // Allow ±5 days for cloud-free image // 2. Data Acquisition & Cloud Masking function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function getNDVI(image) { return image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); } function getImageForDate(targetDate, collection) { const startDate = ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-toleranceDays, 'day'); const endDate = ee.Date(targetDate).advance(toleranceDays, 'day'); return collection .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(geometry) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(getNDVI) .median(); } const s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED'); // Get images for both dates const img1 = getImageForDate(date1, s2); const img2 = getImageForDate(date2, s2); // Check if collections are empty const count1 = s2.filterDate(ee.Date(date1).advance(-toleranceDays, 'day'), ee.Date(date1).advance(toleranceDays, 'day')) .filterBounds(geometry).size().getInfo(); const count2 = s2.filterDate(ee.Date(date2).advance(-toleranceDays, 'day'), ee.Date(date2).advance(toleranceDays, 'day')) .filterBounds(geometry).size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images: ${count1}, 2022 Images: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI and pixel counts const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true); const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: geometry, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: geometry, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const ndvi1 = stats1.NDVI; const ndvi2 = stats2.NDVI; const pixels1 = stats1.NDVI_count; const pixels2 = stats2.NDVI_count; console.log(`2021 NDVI: ${ndvi1?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${pixels1}`); console.log(`2022 NDVI: ${ndvi2?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${pixels2}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (pixels1 === 0 || pixels2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (ndvi1 === null || ndvi2 === null || Math.abs(ndvi1) > 1 || Math.abs(ndvi2) > 1 || isNaN(ndvi1) || isNaN(ndvi2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } const ndviChange = ndvi2 - ndvi1; console.log(`NDVI Change: ${ndviChange.toFixed(3)}`); if (ndviChange < 0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
